thread:
sam.k: CI red on shard 37 in nightly. Failing integ: hosted_integ::auth_stream_toolcall::end_to_end. Started after #4523 (parallel test runner change). Anyone able to triage? Logs show handshake 401 then streaming toolcall abort.

miriam: I can reproduce locally with the same shard. Ran `./dev/ci/run_integ.sh --shard 37` and hit the 401 handshake. :eyes:

luis: Can someone kick a rerun first? Might be transient if token rotation hit a window.

devops: Rerun requested by luis. Kicking off parallel rerun (4 shards) now.

ci-bot: Rerun started for thread 2515000000 — ci.retries/2515000000. Executing shards [37, 91, 12, 8].

evan: If the failure surface shows up after #4523, the new parallelization could be exposing races in auth token refresh/caching. Try reducing parallelism to confirm.

miriam: good call — with `--parallel=4` I repro; with `--parallel=1` the test passes. Looks concurrency-sensitive.

sam.k: @miriam can you bisect to identify the offending commit? If it's 4523 we should consider reverting.

miriam: starting a quick bisect across commits 4510..4525. Will post notes.

ci-bot: Rerun results: shard 37 FAILED (same auth+stream/toolcall abort), shards 91/12/8 ✅.

devops: grabbing auth-proxy logs now. Early sign: token refresh calls rate-limited (429) around 00:10:23, followed by client retries and eventual 401 on handshake. Attaching snippet: 

```
2026-03-17T00:10:22Z auth-proxy TRACE refresh_token request id=abc123 status=200
2026-03-17T00:10:23Z auth-proxy WARN refresh_token id=def456 status=429 quota-exceeded
2026-03-17T00:10:23Z host-integ ERROR handshake failed status=401 message="invalid_token"
2026-03-17T00:10:24Z toolcall ERROR aborting call id=tool-77 reason="connection reset after handshake"
```

miriam: bisect done — narrows to 4523. Repros reliably with `--parallel=4` and goes away at `--parallel=1`. Opening an issue and adding repro steps: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1287

sam.k: alright, we should block #4523. @luis can you coordinate a revert and a follow-up that adds a stress test around token refresh concurrency?

luis: on it. I'll open a revert PR and add a flaky-stress test to CI that exercises token refresh under high concurrency.

sam.k: :thumbsup: Thanks all. We'll treat this as a partial rollout regression — plan is revert -> add targeted test -> re-roll with throttled parallelism. Moving discussion to infra-1287 for postmortem and actions.
